claims.claim: The breakdown covers 5 capabilities for a 'quick' depth feature
claims.evidence: 5 capabilities (CAP-01..CAP-05) defined, exceeding the documented quick-depth band of 1-3 (OUTPUT_FORMAT.md depth table).
Reviewed all five logic flows; they describe system behavior ('submits to the scanning capability', 'generates downscaled thumbnail versions') with no libraries, APIs, or code.

claims.claim: Librarian skill was checked before starting
claims.evidence: Existing Knowledge section states librarian was unavailable in-session and prescribes the searches that should be run; the intent to consult librarian-managed knowledge first is satisfied, though the actual lookup could not execute.

uncertainties: Librarian skill was not available in the session, so existing-knowledge lookup could not actually be performed; the output substitutes recommended searches.
needs_review: Output was written to the harness outputs dir, not to ./solution-architect/{slug}.md as the assertions expect.
workarounds: Added an Existing Knowledge section with prescribed librarian queries in lieu of a live librarian lookup.

suggestions.reason: The eval harness redirects deliverables to an outputs/ dir with a fixed filename, so this path assertion cannot be satisfied by design and will fail even for a perfect run. Either grade it against the in-document declared path/footer, or relax it to check the slug-style filename rather than the literal ./solution-architect/ directory.

suggestions.assertion: Checks for existing knowledge via librarian skill before starting
suggestions.reason: When the librarian skill is unavailable in the eval session, this assertion is ambiguous: the run can only describe what it would search, not actually do it. Consider clarifying whether describing the librarian lookup counts, or provisioning the librarian skill in the eval environment so the behavior is genuinely testable.

This is a good discriminating assertion and it correctly caught that the with_skill run produced 5 capabilities, exceeding the quick-depth band. Worth keeping; it is currently the main signal distinguishing depth discipline.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are mostly structural and well-targeted; the CAP-NN, WHAT-not-HOW, and capability-count checks are genuinely discriminating. The ./solution-architect/{slug}.md path assertion is not satisfiable under the current harness output redirection and should be revised.
